data.name: Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4 - Beta
data.detailed_description:
Beta Rewards


Vault Edition Loyalty Discount

Pre-purchase loyalty discount for previous Call of Duty® owners: 10% off Modern Warfare® 4 Vault Edition for eligible players.

To qualify, must own and have played one of the following Call of Duty® titles on the same Steam account as being used for current Pre-purchase: Modern Warfare® (2019), Black Ops Cold War, Vanguard, Modern Warfare® II (2022), Modern Warfare® III (2023), Black Ops 6, or Black Ops 7. Offer subject to change, applies to pre-purchases only. Offer valid until 23rd October 2026.

Vault Edition Includes

  • Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4

  • Hostile Alliance Operator Pack

    4 Operator Skins: Price, Valeria, Ghost, Blix

  • Special Forces Operator Pack
    4 Operator Skins representing the United Kingdom, Germany, France, and South Korea, each with voice packs in their local languages

  • Signature Weapon Collection
    5 Signature Weapons

  • BlackCell (1 Season)
    Includes: Battle Pass, 20 Tier Skips, 1,100 CP and more

  • DMZ Deployment Bonus
    Additional bonus content in DMZ


About the Game

Open Beta access is available for all players from August 28th - September 1st*.

Experience grounded, precise combat built around fluid movement, player choice and greater control in every engagement with the Modern Warfare® 4 Beta.

Jump into the Beta for a first look at Multiplayer features and content, including:

- Ballistic Authority: New weapon-first technology stack unifies precision aiming, physical handling, realistic audio propagation, enhanced visibility and smarter combat perception into the most authentic Modern Warfare® gunplay yet.

- Movement: Built around fluidity, control and player freedom, delivering fast, grounded combat that keeps Operators responsive through every engagement while expanding how players move, fight and adapt across the environment.

- Maps: A selection of grounded, visually distinct Multiplayer environments spanning locations around the world.

Earn in-game rewards for playing the Beta, which will be immediately available in the Beta once unlocked and playable in Modern Warfare® 4 once the full game launches.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 64 Bit (latest update)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 5 1600 or Intel® Core™ i5-8400
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon™ RX 470, NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 970 / 1060 or Intel® Arc™ A580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 70 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Intel ARC GPUs require Resizable Bar Only Intel/AMD processors (with AVX instruction set) are supported.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 11 64 Bit (latest update)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 5 3600 or Intel® Core™ i7-8700K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon™ RX 6700XT, NVIDIA® GeForce® RTX 3060 or Intel® Arc™ B580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 70 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Intel ARC GPUs require Resizable Bar Only Intel/AMD processors (with AVX instruction set) are supported.

data.legal_notice:
A mobile phone number must be linked to your Steam Account to play Modern Warfare® 4.

TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot required, other security measures may be enforced. Learn more at https://support.activision.com/tpm.

*Actual launch date(s), time(s), and platform availability of Beta subject to change. See www.callofduty.com/beta for more details. Minimum Open Beta duration is 2 days. Limited time only. Internet connection required.

Content, features, services, online play, and support not available in all regions, and may vary, change, or terminate.

Requires an Activision account and acceptance of the Activision Software License and Services Agreement.

For more information, please visit www.callofduty.com.
